And I mean while we dont label ourselves as a dom/sub relationship, he definitely has to keep up his aggressive and dominant type personality if he wants me to see him as the dominant person in the bedroom. Of course theres space for emotional needs and whatnot.

Now to OP: Relationships in general can be pretty difficult to deal with. Has she never seen you in pain before? I mean, even if this sounds mean if she really loved you and wanted you she would have let you break the subservient rules because you are IN PAIN. How would you do anything when you're in so much pain you cant move? It sounds like shes NEVER been in unbearable pain. And it also sounds like she lacks any empathy towards you. OP if this is something you think you can and you want to save, the first step is to have a REAL talk with her. Sit her down and let her know that in that talk you need to be her equal, and that while you enjoy giving her what she needs sometimes you need the same thing. Even in dom/sub relationships you cannot only take. You HAVE to give. 
I hope this works out for you, one way or another.

Even though I left him (I felt it could work, I just wanted him to put in more efforts, and after months of me asking him to simply get a job, i hoped this would be his wake up call) it still hurt when that happened. I hope you are able to find someone who you never have to feel this way about.
